name: decentralised-auction
description: A local-demonstration NFT auction dapp. Hardhat 3 chain, Solidity contracts and a Vite user interface.

scripts.//: Every script below mirrors a Makefile target. Windows PowerShell has no `make`, so use these instead. `npm run help` lists them.
scripts.reset-chain: docker compose rm --stop --force --volumes chain deployer web && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.seed: docker compose run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint sh deployer -c "npm run seed --workspace contracts"
scripts.compose:config: docker compose config --quiet && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml config --quiet && echo "compose: both file sets parse"
scripts.indexer: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.override.yaml -f compose.indexer.yaml --profile indexer up -d --build
scripts.monitoring: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.override.yaml -f compose.monitoring.yaml --profile monitoring up -d --build
scripts.full: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.override.yaml -f compose.indexer.yaml -f compose.monitoring.yaml --profile indexer --profile monitoring up -d --build
